description: This file defines a React component named TenantBootstrapGate that wraps protected routes, ensuring tenant bootstrap logic executes before rendering nested content. It imports React, Outlet from react-router-dom, and a TenantBootstrap component, rendering them together to serve as a route guard.

methods.name: TenantBootstrapGate()
methods.description: React functional component that renders TenantBootstrap and Outlet inside a fragment, acting as a route guard for protected routes.
